newsitem.title: USA: Com/Tech Communication names Lewis CEO.
newsitem.headline: Com/Tech Communication names Lewis CEO.

text.p: Com/Tech Communication Technologies Inc said Wednesday that Eugene Lewis, president and chief operating officer, was named chief executive officer.

The company's former chief executive, Gregory Harper, was appointed chief technology officer, and will focus his attention on emerging technology issues relating to the company's business, Com/Tech said. Both officers continue to serve as directors of the company.
Com/Tech Communication Technologies is a provider of diversified communications technology services.
